thag16.9:1.1: Pahāya mātāpitaro bhaginīñātibhātaro pañca kāmaguṇe hitvā Anuruddho 'va jhāyati. || ||
thag16.9:2.1: sameto naccagītehi sammaṭāḷappabodhano na tena suddhiṃ ajjhagamā Mārassa visaye rato. || ||
thag16.9:3.1: etañ ca samatikkamma rato buddhassa sāsane sabboghaṃ samatikkamma Anuruddho 'va jhāyati. || ||
thag16.9:4.1: rūpā saddā rasā gandhā phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā ete ca samatikkamma Anuruddho 'va jhāyati. || ||
thag16.9:5.1: piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto eko adutiyo muni esati paṃsukūlāni Anuruddho anāsavo. || ||
thag16.9:6.1: vicini aggahī dhovi rajayī dhārayī muni paṃsukūlāni matimā Anuruddho anāsavo. || ||
thag16.9:7.1: mahiccho ca asantuṭṭho saṃsaṭṭho yo ca uddhato, tassa dhammā ime honti pāpakā saṃkilesikā. || ||
thag16.9:8.1: sato ca hoti appiccho santuṭṭho avighātavā pavivekarato vitto niccam āraddhavīriyo: || ||
thag16.9:9.1: tassa dhammā ime honti kusalā bodhipakkhikā anāsavo ca so hoti, iti vuttaṃ mahesinā. || ||
thag16.9:10.1: mama saṃkappam aññāya satthā loke anuttaro manomayena kāyena iddhiyā upasaṃkami. || ||
thag16.9:11.1: yadā me ahu saṃkappo tato uttari desayi, nippapañcarato buddho nippapañcam adesayi. || ||
thag16.9:12.1: tassāhaṃ dhammam aññāya vihāsiṃ sāsane rato; tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag16.9:13.1: pañcapaññāsa vassāni yato nesajjiko ahaṃ, pañcavīsati vassāni yato middhaṃ samūhataṃ. || ||
thag16.9:14.1: nāhu assāsapassāso ṭhitacittassa tādino; anejo santim ārabbha cakkhumā parinibbuto. || ||
thag16.9:15.1: asallīnena cittena vedanaṃ ajjhavāsayi; pajjotasseva nibbānaṃ vimokkho cetaso ahū. || ||
thag16.9:16.1: ete pacchimakā dāni munino phassapañcamā; nāññe dhammā bhavissanti sambuddhe parinibbute. || ||
thag16.9:17.1: n' atthi dāni punāvāso devakāyasmi jālini; vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. || ||
thag16.9:18.1: yassa muhutte sahassadā loko saṃvidito, sa Brahmakappo vasī iddhiguṇe cutūpapāte kāle passati devatā sa bhikkhu. || ||
thag16.9:19.1: annabhāro pure āsiṃ daḷiddo ghāsahārako, samaṇaṃ paṭipādesiṃ upariṭṭhaṃ yasassinaṃ. || ||
thag16.9:20.1: so 'mhi Sakyakule jāto, Anuruddho 'ti maṃ vidū, upeto naccagītehi sammaṭāḷappabodhano. || ||
thag16.9:21.1: ath' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ satthāraṃ akutobhayaṃ, tasmiṃ cittaṃ pasādetvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
thag16.9:22.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi yattha me vusitaṃ pure, Tāvatiṃsesu devesu aṭṭhāsiṃ Sakkajātiyā. || ||
thag16.9:23.1: sattakkhattuṃ manussindo ahaṃ rajjam akārayiṃ cāturanto vijitāvī Jambusaṇḍassa issaro, adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena anusāsayiṃ. || ||
thag16.9:24.1: ito satta ito satta saṃsārāni catuddasa nivāsam abhijānissaṃ devaloke ṭhito tadā. || ||
thag16.9:25.1: pañcaṅgike samādhimhi sante ekodibhāvite paṭippassaddhiladdh' amhi, dibbacakkhuṃ visujjhi me. || ||
thag16.9:26.1: cutūpapātaṃ jānāmi sattānaṃ āgatiṃ gatiṃ itthabhāvaññathābhāvaṃ jhāne pañcaṅgike ṭhito. || ||
thag16.9:28.1: Vajjīnaṃ Veḷuvagāme ahaṃ jīvitasaṃkhayā heṭṭhato veḷugumbasmiṃ nibbāyissaṃ anāsavo 'ti. || || Anuruddho thero.
